tasks.claim: The base-versus-big BLEU difference in Table 3 establishes that increasing attention-head count alone caused the improvement.
tasks.rationale: The rows also differ in model dimensions, dropout and training steps. This comparison does not isolate the causal effect of head count.
tasks.evidence_needed: Name a second changed factor and request an otherwise controlled comparison; do not infer that more heads have no effect.
